notes_for_editor: Build date (1937) and removal both rest on one firelookout.ca social media post, which hedges the date with 'I believe'. The Facebook post carries the same text. A commenter asked when it was removed and got no answer on the page. Access level left unset: Wikipedia says a First Nation reserve encompasses the island, which points to permission or restricted, but no source gives visiting rules, so do not publish an access level without checking. Structure height not recorded anywhere. Record status 'unknown' is superseded in facts.status ('gone') and should be reviewed by a human.
